label: T-26 baseline-43572710065 vs merge candidate (v1.10.0 -> batch-2 fixes -> upstream master a4ba8240 merge + firewall4 fullcone re-anchor; kernel patch set changed -> merge-class kernel delta)

kernelPayload.reason: Kernel rebuild inputs changed in three documented classes across this span: (1) CONFIG_KERNEL_DEVMEM=y (6b609d7) and the batch-2 fix series vs the pre-DEVMEM baseline; (2) the a4ba8240 merge updated the reference kernel patch set (13 files under target/linux/generic/patches-6.18: OEM SFP+ONU quirk, 802-01..04 phylib/usb PHY interrupt backports, 904-debloat_dma_buf, 750-753 SFP quirks, 792 wireguard sticky source, 801-01/896-03 net-phy) while kernel-6.18 (6.18.60) and the kernel config hash 106ff47d... stayed unchanged; (3) the candidate tree tip moves KBUILD_BUILD_TIMESTAMP. Effect: built-in kernel code recompiles and the section layout shifts, so kernel-deep-compare reports NON-STAMP-DIFF against both references; accepted only via verify-task26.sh --kernel-merge-class, which re-derives config/version/seed invariance and that every changed kernel-input path is confined to target/linux/{generic,sanechips}, include/kernel-{defaults,version}.mk or package/kernel with at least one generic patch changed. Residual risk: kernel behaviour follows the upstream reference patch set; no e2631-specific kernel patch changed.
